internalNotes: MITC source: CMITC_V18_28092026 (official YES BANK master MITC, verified 2026-10-03).
Zero forex markup and zero DCC charge confirmed: MITC line 1717-1718 explicitly exempts NIYO Credit Card from forex markup and dynamic currency conversion charges.
Lifetime Free confirmed: NIYO listed in fee table with NIL joining and NIL annual fees (MITC line 222).

Utility & Service transaction fee: 1% + GST on utility spends exceeding ₹50,000 cumulative in a calendar month (NIYO grouped with Marquee/Reserv/Uni — higher ₹50K threshold, not the standard ₹25K for 'other cards'). Cap ₹5,000 per transaction.
Fuel surcharge waiver: ₹500–₹4,000 transaction range (MITC line 1934-1937, grouped with Reserv/YES Essence). Cap ₹250 per statement cycle (MITC line 2013-2016). Waiver does NOT apply to fuel via UPI.

Reward rates confirmed from goniyo.com (2026-10-03): 5 Niyo Coins/₹100 on travel bookings via Niyo app; 4 Niyo Coins/₹100 on domestic e-commerce/online; 2 Niyo Coins/₹100 on domestic POS. International transactions earn 0 coins.
Coin value confirmed from goniyo.com: 10 Niyo Coins = ₹1 (i.e. ₹0.10 per coin). Redemption is for travel bookings and exclusive discounts via the Niyo app.

International lounge access is listed as a 'Niyo Exclusive' benefit on goniyo.com, gated behind the Niyo Premium Membership add-on — NOT a standard card feature on the base card. The earlier assumption of a ₹50K quarterly spend gate was incorrect.

Eligibility per goniyo.com: resident Indians aged 21+ with a credit profile (CIBIL score); fully digital onboarding via Niyo app with Video KYC — no salary slips or income proof required. The YES Bank MITC age range of 21–60 and income criteria (₹25K salary / ₹7.5L ITR) may still apply at bank's discretion.
Finance charge: 3.99% per month / 47.88% p.a. (falls under 'Other Credit Cards' category in the MITC).
Cash withdrawal suspended for first 6 months from onboarding date.
Fuel MCC codes 5541, 5542, 5983, 5172 earn no Niyo Coins. Fuel surcharge waiver still applies separately.
Premium Membership benefits (₹0 convenience fees on flights, 10% off international hotels, lounge access) are add-on features, not base card benefits — do not surface these as standard card benefits.
Card managed entirely through the Niyo app — no YES Bank branch or netbanking required.
